A highly mobile, bouncy artefact. Its formation conditions are unknown, but it is most often found where electrical activity is intense. Its unique structure redistributes kinetic energy and reduces explosive damage, making it highly valuable to researchers and stalkers. Its anomalous nature weakens protection against electrical discharges and chemicals, leaving the bearer more vulnerable in electrical anomalies and toxic environments.

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A beautiful anomalous formation with magnetic properties similar to ultra-dense metals. It generates a powerful gravitational field and an energy aura that greatly increases movement speed. This makes its bearer more susceptible to psi-radiation, turning the “Bat” into a valuable trophy for Zone researchers. Its side effect is reduced protection from explosive damage.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A root-like artefact that floats when it is no longer touching a surface, as if held by an invisible force. Its anomalous structure emits powerful energy that accelerates tissue and organ regeneration, making it invaluable to wounded stalkers. The “Black Angel” also absorbs radiation and gradually cleanses its bearer’s body. Despite its healing properties, it speeds up exhaustion and hampers quick movement.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A massive artefact of gravitational origin. Its extraordinary density makes it extremely heavy and greatly reduces a stalker’s resistance to bullets. Its unique properties gradually remove radiation from the body, making it especially valuable to stalkers who often enter contaminated areas. It is rare, but can be found where gravitational anomalies are active.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A very strange artefact. It does not protect against incoming radiation; instead, it effectively removes radiation already accumulated in the body, reducing the effects of exposure. Extremely rare, it is valued by stalkers and scientists alike.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

An artefact of gravitational origin with unique properties. It greatly reduces the weight of carried cargo, making movement easier even with heavy equipment, and is especially prized by stalkers. It is often found in areas of intense gravitational activity, but its unstable structure calls for careful handling.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

This artefact forms most often in fire anomalies and resembles a reptile’s eye. It greatly increases backpack weight but has good restorative properties. It offers excellent protection from heat by absorbing some of it. Its extreme rarity and effectiveness make it highly sought-after.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A strangely shaped artefact whose core resembles a human organ. It is hard to say whether it was named “Heart” because of its appearance or its healing properties. Most surprising is that it has properties utterly unlike those of artefacts produced by gravitational anomalies, another reminder of how little is understood about the Zone’s workings.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

An artefact born of electrical anomalies. Unlike many other anomalous formations, “Electron” greatly reduces kinetic impact from blows and explosions and partially protects its bearer from psi-waves. These traits make it especially valuable to survivors in the Zone. It remains in high demand among stalkers and research laboratories studying how anomalous energy affects matter.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

Formed under the influence of a nearby thermal anomaly. Collectors prize its unusual shape. It lowers the temperature nearby, providing thermal protection, and speeds blood clotting, making “Loop” a good alternative to ordinary hemostatic agents.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

An electrical artefact that emits a faint energy stream and glows in the dark. Beyond its aesthetic appeal, “Lantern” helps its bearer recover stamina faster. It interests stalkers and scientists studying anomalies; collectors prize its unusual appearance and rarity.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A gravitational anomalous formation. “Fountain” impedes the movement of objects in a small area around it, apparently by generating an unusual gravitational field. Its effect grows more noticeable as moving objects get faster, which led stalkers to use it for protection.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A bright—literally—member of the electrostatic artefact family. It releases a gaseous substance said to benefit the body. Its high effectiveness makes it very popular.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

The artefact generates weak electric currents and an electromagnetic field. As an energy source, it is highly prized outside the Zone. It also stimulates the muscular system, improving performance and lowering the fatigue threshold.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

The artefact’s cup-shaped petals release a powerful gaseous stimulant. Its effects include a positive change in the body’s hormonal balance.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A melted piece of greenish tree resin. Anomalies and emissions have given it unusual properties, greatly reducing the weight of carried cargo. However, it has lost its former ability to absorb radiation and now weakens radiation protection, making it risky to use. “Grapes” should be handled with care, as contact may endanger the bearer’s health.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A hollow, spherical formation resembling translucent parchment. It is covered with a pleasant-feeling film and emits a faint emerald glow. Stalkers value it because it partly neutralises harmful chemicals and reduces radiation’s effects on the body. These properties make “Kislushka” useful to researchers and artefact hunters in toxic, radioactive areas.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A beautiful, glass-like formation created by electrostatic anomalies. Its pronounced dielectric properties greatly improve protection from electrical effects and speed up stamina recovery. However, it also hinders the body’s regeneration, slowing the healing of wounds and other injuries.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

An ultra-dense mass that continuously stimulates the respiratory system, helping restore stamina faster. In a radioactive environment it releases a cloud of colourless gas. The same gas harms the regenerative abilities of living organisms, greatly slowing wound healing and overall health recovery. Prolonged use can therefore be dangerous.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A small-diameter ring with four streamlined triangular segments. Two pairs of opposite charges shift chaotically inside its structure. Its properties are tied to radiation: the artefact effectively removes accumulated radiation from the body.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

An electrical artefact with unique properties. “Moss” combines traits found not only in electrical anomalies but also in other anomalous formations. It greatly increases resistance to psi-effects, protects against electrical discharges and reduces radiation’s harmful effects. However, the artefact itself emits weak radiation, so prolonged use calls for care. Despite this drawback, it is valued by researchers and stalkers seeking artefacts with combined properties.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A crescent-shaped artefact that emits a faint, dim light. “Moon” greatly increases its owner’s resistance to chemicals and radiation. These traits make it popular with stalkers travelling through contaminated, toxic areas. Its drawback is that it noticeably slows tissue regeneration, making wounds harder and slower to heal, so it must be used with care.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

An artefact often found in areas of gravitational activity. “Burdock” uniquely reduces the overall weight of equipment, making it useful to stalkers carrying heavy loads. It also gives its owner extra radiation protection. These properties make it popular with both newcomers and experienced Zone researchers, allowing longer stays in contaminated areas with fewer consequences.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

An artefact formed in thermally unstable areas. “Sandstone” has powerful regenerative properties, speeding wound healing and helping the body recover quickly. It contains a small amount of pure gold, making it valuable to stalkers and collectors alike.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A rare artefact of electromagnetic origin. “Seraphim” generates brief electrical pulses that benefit the body and reduce the need for sleep. Carrying it is no easy task, since every extra kilogram in the Zone matters. Still, its useful properties make it valuable to stalkers, especially those often suffering physical injuries.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

Stalkers also call this artefact “Amulet”. Its main property is a powerful gravitational field with a small radius that reduces the kinetic energy of moving objects within it. This greatly improves ballistic protection. Some stalkers believe it brings good luck, but its real value is the better chance of surviving the Zone’s dangers.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

A very light and fragile artefact. It contains a substance that may benefit the body. According to scientists, it is completely harmless, making it attractive to stalkers and wealthy clients outside the Zone alike.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

It looks like a petrified formation. Offers some protection from explosions and impacts.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

“Phantom Star” is a rare anomalous formation of plasma enclosed in a transparent, pulsing shell. It has a pronounced regenerative effect, accelerating wound healing and greatly increasing stamina, which makes it valuable to stalkers operating in extreme conditions. However, it may weaken the body’s physical protection, so it should be worn with care. Its high value and useful properties make it a coveted find for artefact hunters.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

“Sun” is a rare anomalous formation, believed to have arisen from a symbiosis of gravitational and thermal anomalies. Highly prized by collectors, it is also sought after by stalkers for its unique combination of properties. It speeds wound healing, making it extremely useful in the Zone. However, it weakens the bearer’s heat protection and increases vulnerability to high temperatures, so use it cautiously in dangerous areas.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

In terms of atomic mass, this is essentially pure silicon dioxide. It behaves strangely and differs from natural quartz in both its deep copper-sulfate hue and its mechanical properties. Formed among clusters of “Electra”-type anomalies, this quartz fragment has a complex system of internal currents despite its external dielectric properties.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

One of the few artefacts in the Zone that handles all kinds of physical impact on its bearer well.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

The artefact has a calming effect on the human nervous system and is highly valued by jewellers. It strongly hinders wound healing, but in exchange improves the body’s radiation protection. Its lack of harmful emissions and difficulty to detect make it especially valuable.
 
 
 %c[ui_gray_2]CHARACTERISTICS:

 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] unstable artefact, junk
 %c[d_cyan] • %c[ui_gray_2] cannot be placed in a container

One of the Zone’s most mysterious artefacts, the “Eye of the Noosphere” can send its bearer back in time, perhaps even allowing them to avoid death. Compressing it creates a return point in case its bearer dies. Frequent use changes its colour, while excessive use can stop it working altogether. The “Eye of the Noosphere” gradually regains its power, suggesting that it draws on the energy flowing throughout the Zone.
